# Wave Link triggers

## Channel effects changed

Runs when an effect on a Wave Link channel is switched on or off or added or removed. Also fires for Wave Link 1.x/2.x filters.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Channels** | Which channel to watch: its name as Wave Link shows it, like "Music", or its ID. Separate several with commas. Leave empty for every channel. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%waveLinkChannelName%` | The channel's name |
| `%waveLinkChannelId%` | The channel's ID |
| `%waveLinkChannelMuted%` | true if the whole channel is muted |
| `%waveLinkChannelVolume%` | The channel's volume (0-100) |
| `%waveLinkEffectName%` | The effect that changed |
| `%waveLinkEffectEnabled%` | true if that effect is on now |

<small>Type id: `wavelink.channelEffectsChanged`</small>

## Channel mute changed

Runs when a channel (or one of its mixes) is muted or unmuted in Wave Link. Handy for an on-screen 'music muted' sign.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Channels** | Which channel to watch: its name as Wave Link shows it, like "Music", or its ID. Separate several with commas. Leave empty for every channel. |
| **Mixes** | Only react to this mix, like "Stream Mix". Separate several with commas. Leave empty to react to any mix, and to changes of the whole channel. |
| **State** | Muted: only when it became muted. Not muted: only when it became unmuted. Any: both. Options: Any, Muted, Not muted. Starts as: `Any`. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%waveLinkChannelName%` | The channel's name |
| `%waveLinkChannelId%` | The channel's ID |
| `%waveLinkChannelMuted%` | true if the whole channel is muted |
| `%waveLinkChannelVolume%` | The channel's volume (0-100) |
| `%waveLinkScope%` | channel if the whole channel changed, mix if only one of its mixes changed |
| `%waveLinkMixName%` | The mix that changed (only when waveLinkScope is mix) |
| `%waveLinkMuted%` | true if it is muted now, false if not |

<small>Type id: `wavelink.channelMuteChanged`</small>

## Channel updated

Runs when anything about a Wave Link channel changes, such as its volume, mute or effects. It runs alongside the more exact triggers.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Channels** | Which channel to watch: its name as Wave Link shows it, like "Music", or its ID. Separate several with commas. Leave empty for every channel. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%waveLinkChannelName%` | The channel's name |
| `%waveLinkChannelId%` | The channel's ID |
| `%waveLinkChannelMuted%` | true if the whole channel is muted |
| `%waveLinkChannelVolume%` | The channel's volume (0-100) |

<small>Type id: `wavelink.channelUpdated`</small>

## Channel volume changed

Runs when the volume of a channel (or of one of its mixes) changes in Wave Link.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Channels** | Which channel to watch: its name as Wave Link shows it, like "Music", or its ID. Separate several with commas. Leave empty for every channel. |
| **Mixes** | Only react to this mix, like "Stream Mix". Separate several with commas. Leave empty to react to any mix, and to changes of the whole channel. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%waveLinkChannelName%` | The channel's name |
| `%waveLinkChannelId%` | The channel's ID |
| `%waveLinkChannelMuted%` | true if the whole channel is muted |
| `%waveLinkChannelVolume%` | The channel's volume (0-100) |
| `%waveLinkScope%` | channel if the whole channel changed, mix if only one of its mixes changed |
| `%waveLinkMixName%` | The mix that changed (only when waveLinkScope is mix) |
| `%waveLinkVolume%` | The new volume (0-100) |
| `%waveLinkPreviousVolume%` | The volume before the change |

<small>Type id: `wavelink.channelVolumeChanged`</small>

## Channels changed

Runs when channels are added or removed in Wave Link, so the list of channels is different.

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%waveLinkChannelsCount%` | How many channels there are now |

<small>Type id: `wavelink.channelsChanged`</small>

## Connected

Runs when Cuebot connects to Wave Link. It works with Wave Link 3 and the older 1.x/2.x. Wave Link only exists on Windows and macOS.

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%waveLinkApi%` | 3 for Wave Link 3, legacy for Wave Link 1.x/2.x |
| `%waveLinkPort%` | The port Cuebot connected on |

<small>Type id: `wavelink.connected`</small>

## Create profile requested

Runs when Wave Link 3 asks to create a new profile. The variables say what kind of device it is for and which mixes it lists.

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%waveLinkDeviceType%` | The kind of device the profile is for |
| `%waveLinkProfileMixes%` | The mixes listed, separated by commas |
| `%waveLinkProfileMixesCount%` | How many mixes are listed |

<small>Type id: `wavelink.createProfileRequested`</small>

## Disconnected

Runs when Cuebot loses or ends its connection to Wave Link, for example when you close Wave Link.

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%reason%` | Why the connection ended |

<small>Type id: `wavelink.disconnected`</small>

## DSP effects changed

Runs when a built-in effect of a microphone or input device changes (like Clipguard or low cut).

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Input devices** | Which microphone or other input device to watch, by name or ID. Separate several with commas. Leave empty for every input device. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%waveLinkInputDeviceName%` | The input device's name |
| `%waveLinkEffectName%` | The effect that changed |
| `%waveLinkEffectEnabled%` | true if that effect is on now |

<small>Type id: `wavelink.inputDspEffectsChanged`</small>

## Focused app changed

Runs when the program you are using (the one in front) changes, as Wave Link 3 sees it. Handy for routing that program's sound to a channel.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Applications** | Which program to react to, by name or ID, like "Spotify". Separate several with commas. Leave empty for any program. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%waveLinkAppName%` | The program's name |
| `%waveLinkAppId%` | The program's ID |
| `%waveLinkChannelName%` | The channel the program plays on, if any |

<small>Type id: `wavelink.focusedAppChanged`</small>

## Level meter updated

Runs while Wave Link reports sound levels. Switch level meters on at the Wave Link page first; they are off by default. Cuebot limits how often this runs.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Meter** | Which kind of meter to watch: a channel, a mix, an input device or an output device. Any means all of them. Level meters must be switched on first (see below). Options: Any, Channel, Mix, Input, Output. Starts as: `Any`. |
| **Meter names** | Names or IDs of the meters to watch, separated by commas. Leave empty for every meter. |
| **Minimum level (0-100)** | Only run when the meter is at least this loud, from 0 (silent) to 100 (loudest). Leave empty to ignore how loud it is. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%waveLinkLevelName%` | The name of the loudest matching meter |
| `%waveLinkLevelType%` | Its kind: channel, mix, input or output |
| `%waveLinkLevelLeft%` | Left loudness (0-100) |
| `%waveLinkLevelRight%` | Right loudness (0-100) |
| `%waveLinkLevelPeak%` | The louder of left and right (0-100) |
| `%waveLinkLevelsCount%` | How many meters moved |

<small>Type id: `wavelink.levelMeter`</small>

## Main output device changed

Runs when you pick a different main output device in Wave Link, the one you listen on.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Output devices** | Which output device (speakers or headphones) to watch, by name or ID. Separate several with commas. Leave empty for every output device. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%waveLinkOutputDeviceName%` | The new main output device |
| `%waveLinkOutputDeviceId%` | Its ID |
| `%waveLinkPreviousOutputDeviceId%` | The ID of the one before |

<small>Type id: `wavelink.mainOutputChanged`</small>

## Output mix changed

Runs when an output device is set to play a different mix in Wave Link (Wave Link 1.x/2.x: when you switch between Monitor Mix and Stream Mix).

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Output devices** | Which output device (speakers or headphones) to watch, by name or ID. Separate several with commas. Leave empty for every output device. |
| **Mixes** | Only react when the output switched to this mix, by name or ID. Separate several with commas. Leave empty for any mix. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%waveLinkOutputDeviceName%` | The output device |
| `%waveLinkOutputMixName%` | The mix it plays now |
| `%waveLinkPreviousMixName%` | The mix it played before (Wave Link 3) |
| `%waveLinkPreviousMixId%` | The ID of the mix it played before |

<small>Type id: `wavelink.outputMixChanged`</small>
